scope: Optional sensitivity analysis; never main benchmark eligibility

meta_texture_basis_v1: Treat reported texture columns as dry-mass percentages of fine earth below 2000 micrometres.
Treat analytical methods and endpoint conventions as comparable to the requested PTF contract.
Use a reported 50-micrometre sand cutoff as the USDA sand lower boundary; assume no unreported coarse material.
These assumptions do not establish measured USDA fractions.
meta_reported_boundary_proxy_v1: Use reported below-1-micrometre clay and 1-50-micrometre silt as proxies for USDA below-2 and 2-50 fractions.
This limiting scenario neglects the unobserved 1-2-micrometre mass; it is not an exact rebin.
Respect source-local below-2-micrometre overrides already recorded in the dataset mapping.
meta_log_psd_boundary_v1: Interpolate cumulative mass linearly in log10 diameter between adjacent available boundaries.
Use reported below-1 and below-10 micrometre values when available; otherwise use the below-50 cumulative value.
Derive below-50 mass from clay plus silt or from 100 minus reported sand under assumed closure.
Wide-bin interpolation is approximate, regardless of resolution, because the source material/mass basis remains assumed.
Never extrapolate a missing clay boundary or invent a missing lower-tail distribution.
meta_texture_closure_v1: Assume a closed partition when deriving one missing texture fraction from two reported fractions.
If all three reported fractions exist, allow normalization to 100 only when the absolute closure residual is at most one percentage point.
Reject negative fractions, nonmonotone cumulative mass and larger closure discrepancies.
meta_density_v1: Interpret positive column Q values as dry bulk density in grams per cubic centimetre.
Assume the material and analytical protocol are comparable to the PTF contract; do not infer profile identity.
meta_organic_v1: Interpret column R as organic carbon mass percent; treat its material and analytical protocol as comparable to the PTF contract.
Treat column S humus content as an organic-matter proxy in mass percent.
Use the fixed coefficient 1.724 only when deriving a missing OC or OM value; record the coefficient and source cell.
Never replace an available reported organic value with a derived alternative.
meta_target_material_v1: Treat retained canonical water observations as applicable to the candidate's target material basis when that basis is unresolved or different.
Preserve original quantity, unit, denominator, material, value and observation provenance in the trace.
This material comparability assumption never establishes main eligibility.
meta_target_density_conversion_v1: For the same assumed material, convert volumetric to gravimetric water as mass_ratio = volume_fraction * water_density / dry_bulk_density; invert for gravimetric to volumetric.
Use the registered water density of 1.0 gram per cubic centimetre and approximate bulk density from column Q.
Reconstruct in the original experimental water basis before applying this approximate density conversion.
Never borrow a density from another sample or extrapolate beyond the measured pressure range.
